textos.Como em toda competição phygital, o conf: As in every phygital competition, the match does not end on the pitch or on the console: it happens on both. Each game has one half played in the video game and the other on a small-sided pitch, and the final score is the sum of the two. A team that builds a lead in the digital half goes onto the pitch in front, but rarely leaves with the result secured — that was the case in 14 of the 20 games in the 2025 edition.
